newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse index closes up, Mobil rises again.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse index closes up, Mobil rises again.

text.p: Ghana's stock exchange index closed higher on Wednesday with Mobil Oil Ghana, up 100 cedis at 6,400 cedis, once again leading the rises, its market report showed.
The all-share index rose 1.65 points to 385.85 from 384.20 points on Monday.

Monday's market report gave the closing index value as 379 points but Wednesday's report explained the index had been revised to reflect additional, or bonus, Standard Chartered Bank shares that began trading on Monday.
The volume of shares traded on Wednesday edged up to 55,140 compared with 47,200 on Monday and 423,470 on Friday.
Mobil, which rose 100 cedis on Monday, began the year on 5,900 and fell back to 5,000 before picking up again.
Other rises on Wednesday were posted by Ghana Commercial Bank, up 10 to 665, consumer products company Unilever, up five to 865, and Mechanical Lloyd Co, which rose two to 80.
Shares on offer decreased to 185,760 from 301,920 on Monday and 676,890 on Friday. Bids totalled 4,804,180.
